chapter.heading: A Call to Worship and Obedience
chapter.v:
Oh come,
let us sing to the Lord!Let us shout joyfully to the Rock of our salvation. [Jer. 48:18]

Let us
come before His presence with thanksgiving;Let us shout joyfully to Him with psalms. [Ex. 11:5; Jer.]

For the
Lord is the great God,And the great King above all gods. [Is. 3:17; 20:4 f [Rom. 12:19]]

In His
hand are the deep places of the earth;The heights of the hills are His also. [Jer. 50:34]

The sea
is His, for He made it;And His hands formed the dry land. [1 Sam. 2:9 i Is. 13:19; [Dan. 2:37]; Rev. 17:18]

Oh come,
let us worship and bow down;Let us kneel before the Lord our Maker. [2 Sam. 24:14] [Is. 43:28 l Deut.]

For He
is our God,And we are the people of His pasture,And the sheep of His hand.Today, if you will hear His voice: [Rev. 18:7] [Deut. 32:29; Jer. 5:31; Ezek. 7:2,] [Is. 42:25; 46:8]

“Do not
harden your hearts, as in the rebellion,As in the day of trial in the wilderness,

When your
fathers tested Me;They tried Me, though they saw My work. [Ps. 73:19; 1 Thess. 5:3; Rev.]

For forty
years I was grieved with that generation,And said, ‘It is a people who go astray in their hearts,And they do not know My ways.’ [Is. 13:6; Jer. 51:8, 43; Luke 17:27; 1 Thess. 5:3 s Is.] [Is. 29:15; Ezek. 8:12; 9:9]

So I
swore in My wrath,‘They shall not enter My rest.’ ”
